categories.question: Which tree would you plant in a small courtyard?

outcomes.name: Eastern redbud
outcomes.description: Slender grey branches covered with pea-shaped pink blossoms emerging directly from the wood

outcomes.name: Japanese flowering cherry
outcomes.description: Small gracefully spreading tree with masses of pale pink spring blossoms

outcomes.name: Olive tree
